context_requirements: Expression of calcineurin (PPP3CA/PPP3R) and NFAT transcription factors
Active calcineurin-NFAT signaling, e.g., in T cells or endothelial cells
Presence of immunophilins (FKBP1A, PPIA) for drug binding
falsifiers: No change in NFAT target genes (e.g., RCAN1, IL2) at 6 h or 24 h
No antiproliferative or apoptotic signature at 24 h
Strong upregulation of NFAT-dependent cytokines (IL2, IFNG) instead of downregulation
No difference in response between cell lines with high vs. low calcineurin/NFAT expression

evidence.supports: FKBP38 inhibits calcineurin and blocks apoptosis, linking calcineurin inhibition to apoptosis regulation
Calcineurin-NFAT signaling is important in endothelial cells and tumor angiogenesis; cyclosporin A rescues endothelial defects
Calcineurin inhibitors cyclosporine and tacrolimus increase oxidative stress markers (p22, TGF-beta, HO-1) in kidney transplant patients
Cyclosporine A and FK506 induce apoptosis in endothelial cells, attenuated by thrombomodulin
RCAN3 inhibits calcineurin and down-regulates NFAT-dependent cytokine gene expression
